description.value: Greek Fellas Restaurant is a family-owned Greek dining destination in Delta, BC, originally founded in 2002 and revived under the same family in 2022. Situated on River Road near the Fraser River—a corridor frequented by touring cyclists—it serves traditional dishes such as Chicken Souvlaki and Roast Lamb made from family recipes and fresh local produce. The restaurant also offers catering services, making it a potential stop for larger cycling groups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a legitimate, active Greek family restaurant re-opened in 2022 with an 'ORDER NOW' button indicating online ordering/takeout capability. Phone number matches between OSM and website. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all remain null per evidence rules. OSM hours and website hours appear to differ, flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM hours and website hours appear to differ; website should be treated as more current.
Street address (11008 River Road) is not corroborated by website content—only 'Delta, BC' is mentioned.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active restaurant on River Road (a known cycling corridor), but none of the three required WWC criteria—bike parking, water refill, or washrooms—can be confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification is needed before a directory listing is appropriate.
enrichment_extras.notes: River Road in Delta runs along the south arm of the Fraser River and is a popular cycling route, giving this restaurant genuine relevance to touring cyclists if required criteria can be confirmed on-site.
